[[Seedborn Flatbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[flatbow]] dropped by [[Seed of Suffering]], a [[boss]] who is found in [[Domain of Fear]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as a [[Bramble Flatbow]] [[dye]]d white.
